read.thesis: Mosaic is curtailing phosphate output (about half of Bartow and Louisiana) as sulfur hits $1,200/t marginal cost, while capex is cut $250M to $1.25B; Q2 stripping margins guided above $400/t on 60% committed book.

utilisation.quote: Bartow, Riverview, and Four Corners had phosphoric acid operating rates at or above 80%, which is in line with our targets.

capex.peers_comment: Management said other competitors have significantly curtailed production primarily due to sulfur availability.
capex.quote: we have lowered our 2026 CapEx guidance by $250 million to $1.25 billion

triggers.label: Capex cut $250M to $1.25B
triggers.quote: we have lowered our 2026 CapEx guidance by $250 million to $1.25 billion

triggers.label: Partial curtailment Bartow and Louisiana
triggers.quote: Louisiana partial curtailment is about half of its production capacity at roughly 1.4 million tons

triggers.label: Q1 stripping margin near $400/t
triggers.quote: allowed us to realize stripping margins near $400 per ton for the quarter

triggers.label: Brazil fertilizer use to contract
triggers.quote: 2026 is likely going to be a contraction in fertilizer use in Brazil

triggers.label: Phosphate and Brazil guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: that is why we pulled guidance—we do not feel comfortable being able to give you a forecast on that

guidance.quote: we have lowered our 2026 CapEx guidance by $250 million to $1.25 billion
the $300 million to $500 million pretty much continues to be our estimate for release
second quarter realized stripping margins will be in excess of $400 per ton for our sales book
full-year expectations shift to $105 per ton–$110 per ton
We expect Mosaic Biosciences revenues to double again in 2026
expected to generate annualized expense savings of $50 million, of which $15 million will be realized this year

prior_guidance_check.quote: We have been saying that $300 million to $500 million release of working capital.
